name: SynPower Co., Ltd.
summary: SynPower Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise specializing in the development and distribution of machinery and critical materials for the printed circuit board (PCB), photonics, and semiconductor sectors. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses advanced equipment tailored for diverse PCB applications, such as flexible PCBs (FPCBs) and substrate boards, in addition to optical automation solutions. The company further extends its offerings to include artificial intelligence (AI) and smart manufacturing technologies, wet processing systems, and visual application solutions. Established in 2002, SynPower Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
